glass.official_category: Glass Bottles and Jars & Other Containers

modulation.passive_factors_in_rates: No passive eco-modulation column. Acceptance status (USCL = on the statewide collection list, PRO = PRO take-back list, N/A = not accepted) is priced into the base fee; ORS 459A.884(3)(a) requires non-accepted materials to carry a higher average base fee than accepted ones.

active_bonuses.name: LCA Bonus A (disclosure)
active_bonuses.adjustment: 10% of base fees on the SKU's primary packaging, excluding the reserve share (about 8% net)
active_bonuses.cap: $20,000 per LCA / SKU or batch; max 10 SKUs or batches to start
active_bonuses.timing: LCA completed on or after 2025-07-01; first-cycle submissions due 2025-08-15, granted in 2026

active_bonuses.name: LCA Bonus B (impact reduction)
active_bonuses.adjustment: Multiple of Bonus A by impact-reduction tier: 10-40% reduction x2.0, 40-70% x2.5, 70%+ x3.0 (DEQ raised Tier 2 and 3 from 2.25 and 2.5 on 2025-09-12)
active_bonuses.cap: Plan caps $40,000 / $45,000 / $50,000 per SKU or batch (caps not restated for DEQ's raised multipliers)
active_bonuses.timing: Packaging changes from December 2024 onward; submit by 2026-05-31; credited against 2027 base fees

active_bonuses.name: LCA Bonus C (switch to reuse or refill)
active_bonuses.cap: $40,000 (projected return rates) or $50,000 (actual return or refill rates) per SKU or batch
active_bonuses.timing: Switch made on or after 2024-12-01; submit by 2026-05-31; credited against 2027 base fees

modulation.maluses: None in force. The program plan says CAA will need to use maluses once reliable LCA data exist.
state_targets: ORS 459A.926: statewide recycling rate for plastic packaging and plastic food serviceware of at least 25% by 2028, 50% by 2040, 70% by 2050 (EQC may adjust after 2038-01-01, between 35% and 70%)

notes: SECONDARY. The CAA 2026 Oregon Producer Fee Schedule (posted 2025-10-29) could not be opened (its host was blocked). The official schedule prints rates in cents per lb to one decimal; these are dollar conversions rounded to the cent by the secondary sources. Corrugated, film, PP film, laminates, glass, aluminum and steel come from SPI (2026-10-26) and agree with EcoEnclose (2026-10-14) and EPR Atlas $/tonne figures. Kraft Paper, Paperboard and Other Paper Laminates come only from EcoEnclose (paperboard also agrees with EPR Atlas 'Uncoated Paper/Board' $176/t = $0.08/lb). Left out: molded-pulp (no 2026 rate found for 'Other Paper Packaging'; the separate molded-pulp row only appears in 2027) and eps-foam (only the PS foamed CONTAINERS row, $1.38/lb, was found; the cushioning/void-fill row that covers packing peanuts was not found). Rates are invoiced as listed; 2026 had no reserve drawdown and SIM was zero on every row (per SPI).
